description: Election Commission - Declare that I. Liyana Arachchi as Member of the Buttala PS
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with filling a vacancy in a local government body (Buttala Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral procedures, candidate nominations, and the declaration of an elected member, which falls squarely under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral processes and related matters.
